description: Registry of clause tags for docs that carry stable clause identifiers and normative language. Tags: 'check-exists' — a named, runnable check already guards the clause (check-ref points at it); 'checkable' — a mechanical check can guard the clause but is not built yet (check-ref names the intended check and any interim probe); 'judgment-only' — compliance is a per-change judgment no check can decide (justification says why). A clause that binds a server is 'check-exists' when a runnable check pins its observable behaviour on the reference server: the check-ref names the reference server as the implementation under test, and every other server is bound by the clause's text alone. Clause identifiers are stable: never renumbered, and a retired identifier stays reserved (listed under 'retired'). A row that states a check-ref may also carry 'test-cases': the identifiers of the test cases pinning the clause, each of which the registry check resolves against the declarators of the anchor-bearing files that row's check-ref cites by path — the title a bare 'it'/'test' call states in a .js or .mjs file, or the name an 'fn' declares in a .rs one. The field is opt-in, and stating it is what puts those identifiers under the check.
